title: Auth — OOB Grant — payload
description: The member's decision on one out-of-band request, as an attestation. For `login`: "let this starter key act as me at this origin until sessionEndsAt, having seen this context" — and, where the grant carries `signingScope`, "and sign documents of these task families as me for that session". For `deviceEnrol`: "let this VTA, which I administer, enrol this starter key under this ACL scope, having seen this context". Or a decline of either. Issued by the identified DID and signed for assertionMethod; carried only inside auth/oob/respond. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

purpose.description: The purpose from step 2, repeated so the signed grant says what it authorizes. `login` arms a session; `deviceEnrol` lets the VTA create an ACL entry.

decision.description: The member's decision. A decline still names the context it declines, and needs no user verification.

sessionKey.description: The starter key `K_b`, from step 2. On approve of a `login`, the only key the grant lets act as the issuer; of a `deviceEnrol`, the only key the VTA may make the subject of the entry.

approverKey.description: The lock key `K_a`. MUST equal the issuer of the respond that carries this document.

origin.description: The origin from step 2: for `login`, the portal origin at which the session key may act; for `deviceEnrol`, the origin of the VTA's Trust Task endpoint.

contextDigest.description: SHA-256 multihash over the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical form of the signed step 2 response document (the auth/oob/prove/0.4 response), proof included, written as multibase. Producers emit base58btc (`z…`). Binds the decision to exactly what the member was shown.

sessionEndsAt.description: `login` only, and then REQUIRED: the latest instant the session key may act as the issuer, as an RFC 3339 date-time. The service ends the session at the earlier of this and its own session limit. MUST be absent for `deviceEnrol`.

signingScope.description: The task families the starter key may sign documents for as the issuer, for the session this grant arms — step 2's `signingScope`, copied unchanged. Absent: the grant delegates no signing. Whatever it names, a service never accepts the key for the exclusions auth/oob/grant/0.4 states (Conformance, consumer item 6), and never beyond the member's own standing. `login` only: MUST be absent for `deviceEnrol`.

aclScope.description: `deviceEnrol` only: the access the approver chooses for the starter key, within step 2's `requestedScope`. REQUIRED on approve, and MUST be absent on decline (the schema says so). MUST be absent for `login`.

decision.description: An approval, which must carry the scope the person chose; a decline must carry none.
